column1: Take a break. The world is waiting.
Aim. Match three. Keep the ancient gate sealed.
column2: 瞄准三连消除，守住古老神庙

column1: Swap colours to reach pairs. Every ninth shot is a blast.
column2: 交换颜色寻找同色组合，每九发有一次爆破
再发射 %d 次获得爆破

column1: DANGER! THE CHAIN IS NEAR THE GATE
column2: 危险！球链即将抵达终点

column1: Match 3+ adjacent colours. Gaps close into chain reactions.
column2: 三个相邻同色球消除，缺口闭合可触发连锁

column1: Mouse: click to fire / Space to swap. Touch: drag aim, lift to fire.
column2: 鼠标点击发射，空格换球；触屏拖动瞄准，抬手发射

column1: 1. Aim at the moving chain, then click to launch a marble.
column2: 1. 瞄准移动球链，点击发射彩球

column1: 2. Touch: drag to aim; lift your finger to shoot.
column2: 2. 触屏拖动瞄准，抬起手指发射

column1: 3. Three or more adjacent colours disappear together.
column2: 3. 三个或更多相邻同色球一起消除

column1: 4. Matching ends close the gap and create chain reactions.
column2: 4. 缺口两端同色时，闭合可形成连锁

column1: 5. Space / right click / SWAP exchanges current and next.
column2: 5. 空格、右键或交换按钮切换当前与下一颗

column1: 6. Every ninth shot blasts nearby marbles of any colour.
column2: 6. 每九发获得爆破，消除周围任意颜色彩球

column1: 7. Clear all marbles before the leading one enters the gate.
column2: 7. 在领头彩球抵达终点前清空全部彩球
